description:
A cheerful, serious girl. At best she`s pure, but at worst she`s gullible. At a young age she was found by her master Priscilla, and loves her like a parent. She admires her master`s use of alcumy to help people, and studies to become an alcumist. Her master taught her magic and martial arts as practical wisdom, so she can also eliminate demons. When it comes to sexual stuff she`s unmotivated, and she understands that she needs to collect semen, but is too embarrassed to do so.
Source: ACDB
name: Colette
